# Card

A 14px container that groups one thing: neutral by default, tonal in its module's colours on hub pages, with media, compact list and whole-card link variants.

`SongNodes.Card` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Card>…</SongNodes.Card>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Card">…</x-import>
```

## Props (CardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"neutral" \| "tonal" \| "media" \| "list" \| "link"` | Variant: neutral (default), tonal, media, list or link. |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module scope for tonal, media placeholders and link hover. |
| `image` | `string` | Image URL for media cards. |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | Eyebrow line above the title. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Card title (for link cards this becomes the one primary link). |
| `href` | `string` | Destination for link cards; the whole card is clickable. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` | Footer actions, pinned to the bottom so grid heights align. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | Compact padding. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Body. |
